findings.title: Detail enrichment lookup wrongly uses offered-only list
findings.problem: _build_assistant_detail_response now calls get_tools_info(user=user, offered_only=True) to enrich settings_config flags for an assistant's saved toolkits and nested assistants. This is a lookup of saved tools, not an offering.
findings.impact: A saved assistant that uses a hidden Google/Tavily tool gets no match in the lookup, so its settings_config flag is not enriched; also contradicts requirement 12 (lookup unchanged). Consequence is limited to the flag.
findings.recommendation: Revert to ToolsInfoService.get_tools_info(user=user); enrichment is a lookup, not an offering.
findings.check_notes: catalog.py:219 now calls get_tools_info(user=user) without offered_only; lookup restored.

fix.change: catalog.py detail enrichment lookup reverted to get_tools_info(user=user)
